questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

She itself are responsible for this situation of hers.
questions.s:
The correct answer is- herself is​.

Key Points

  • Reflexive pronouns are words ending in -self or -selves that are used when the subject and the object of a sentence are the same.
  • The nine English reflexive pronouns are:
    • myself, yourself, himself, herself, oneself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, and themselves.
  • Example: 
    • Jack decided to reward himself with a dinner out.
  • As the singular pronoun 'She' has been used in the former part of the sentence, 'herself is' will be the correct choice.​
     

Correct sentence- She herself is responsible for this situation of hers.

 ​​​​Additional Information  

  • Reflexive pronouns do not work as the main subject but the subject pronoun does.
  • Example:
    • Myself will conduct today’s meeting. (incorrect)
    • I will conduct today’s meeting. (correct)

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.


A computer can't function without it's mother board.

[CGL TIER -I 2024]
questions.s:
The correct answer is: "its"

"It's" is a contraction for "it is" or "it has," but here you need the possessive form of "it," which is "its."

The sentence should read: "A computer can't function without its motherboard."

questions.s: 'Adopt' means to take up; 'Adapt' means to adjust or modify oneself. 'Adapt' is the correct word here followed by the preposition 'to'.

questions.s: In a reported question/indirect speech, the sentence structure should be Subject + Verb, not the interrogative format. Use "why the marketing team decided".
